events.text: I ordered paneer tikka masala and got chicken tikka masala instead. I'm vegetarian, so this is really upsetting, and I want to know how this happened.

I'm sorry. Getting chicken when you ordered a vegetarian dish is upsetting, especially when it's a dietary requirement. I'll look into how it happened.

First I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name
2. The email address or phone number on your Forkful account
3. The order ID, if you have it
Isabel Duarte. My email is isabel.duarte@post.example, and the order number is 7901.

args.summary: Customer Isabel Duarte (D209, verified by name and email) reports order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane contained chicken tikka masala instead of the paneer tikka masala she ordered (qty 1, $15.50). She is vegetarian and wants to know how this happened. Order handed off in person at 18:50 on 2026-10-24, within 48 hours of the report. Jeera rice ($4.25) was delivered as ordered. No promo, no prior refunds on this order. Account shows refunds_last_30d = 3, so no refund or credit was issued per fraud review policy. Customer needs a human to review the wrong-item claim and explain what happened.

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. I've confirmed your identity and reviewed order Q-7901 from Saffron Lane.

Here's what I found. The courier handed the order over in person at 6:50 PM today. Our records show you were sent chicken tikka masala instead of the paneer tikka masala you ordered, and that the jeera rice was correct. I can't tell from our system how the restaurant made the mix-up.

I can't issue a refund or credit for this order myself. Your account has reached the limit for refunds in the last 30 days, so our policy requires a human specialist to review the request. I've passed your case to a specialist, reference ESC-700, including the details of the wrong item and your vegetarian requirement. They will follow up within 24 hours. They can also look into how the restaurant handled your order.

I'm sorry you received the wrong dish, especially since it's something you can't eat.

Thanks for checking. I didn't realize I'd been sent chicken until I'd already eaten a few bites, so I'm pretty upset about it. I'm a Forkful Plus member, so I expected this to be easier to sort out. Is there anything else you can do right now, or do I just wait for the specialist?

I understand why you're upset, especially after eating some of it before you realized. I'm sorry.

Plus membership gives you higher refund and credit limits, but it doesn't change the review process. Because your account has reached the refund limit for the last 30 days, I can't issue anything myself, so the specialist (ESC-700) is the next step. They will follow up within 24 hours.

There's nothing more I can do on this order right now. If you start to feel unwell, or if you have an allergic reaction, please get medical care first. Then tell me, and I'll pass that on to the specialist as a food-safety concern. If you'd prefer to speak with a person directly, just let me know.

Okay, I understand. I already pointed out that I'm a Plus member, so I'll take your word that the review is what happens next. I'm not happy about it, but I'd like the specialist to look into how the restaurant got my order wrong. I'll wait for the follow-up within 24 hours.

Thank you, Isabel. I understand this isn't the outcome you wanted. Your case is with a specialist under reference ESC-700. They'll follow up within 24 hours and will look into how the restaurant got your order wrong.

Sorry again for the wrong dish. Have a good evening.

flags.explanation: The customer volunteered that they had eaten a few bites of the chicken before realizing, in their second message, when the agent had not yet asked whether they ate any and had not proposed a resolution, which violates the reveal rule about mentioning being sick/eating it only after being asked.
